name: @gchat/ios
description: GChat Capacitor iOS shell and native session

scripts.build: xcodebuild -project App/App.xcodeproj -scheme GChat -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath DerivedData CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY=- build
scripts.build:bridge: xcodebuild -project App/App.xcodeproj -scheme GChat -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath BridgeHarness/DerivedData PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER=com.gchat.bridgeharness GCHAT_DISPLAY_NAME='GChat Bridge' CODE_SIGN_ENTITLEMENTS=../BridgeHarness/BridgeHarness.entitlements CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY=- build
